Mix: Blend between the input (0) and the effect (1).
Bypass: Pass in1 through unchanged; the effect does not cook.
Resolutionmode: input: follow in1's resolution (or the demo source when unconnected). custom: use Resolution.
Resolution: Output size in pixels when Resolutionmode is custom.
Look: Colour scheme of the built-in demo source only (used when in1 is unconnected). original: default colours. mono: black and bone-white. A connected input is not recoloured.
Accent: 0-1. In mono Look, turns the mid-bright band of the image red. No effect in original Look.
Mode: Symmetry type. N-fold radial; mirror tiles square, triangle or hex; hyperbolic Poincare disk {P,Q}.
Segments: Number of mirrored segments (N) in radial mode, or P in hyperbolic mode.
Hyperq: Q of the hyperbolic {P,Q} tiling; forced valid so that (P-2)(Q-2) > 4. Only in hyperbolic mode.
Tiles: Number of tiles across the image in the tile modes.
Rotation: Rotation of the pattern in degrees.
Zoom: Zoom of the pattern. Above 1 zooms in.
Srczoom: How much of the source image is used. Lower = smaller source region, magnified.
Center: Centre of the pattern (X, Y). In hyperbolic mode it drives a Moebius translation of the tiling.
Animate: On: the pattern spins and drifts over time.
Speed: Rate of the spin and drift when Animate is on.
Noisespeed: Animation speed of the built-in demo source (used when in1 is unconnected).
